conditions.displayName: Cleanup process failure including import or OOM

documentation.content: Inspect content-free maintenance failure logs. Verify indexes, runtime identity and image imports. No provider sends occur in cleanup. Single completed failure is intentional: this hourly job has already exhausted its configured retry. Waiting for three executions would hide a cleanup outage for hours.

Recovery may be stalled; check readiness and indexes. Never reset running rows or leases blindly. Requires at least 3 matching log entries in a 15-minute alignment window, summed across instances. Counts log entries, not distinct messages. See the runbook for ingestion delay and verification.
